title: weigela florida var. pauciflora
intro: Weigela florida var. pauciflora, commonly known as the dwarf weigela, is a compact shrub with vibrant flowers and a moderate growth rate. As an herbal plant, it is valued for its potential health benefits, including the relief of anxiety and stress, due to its calming properties. The therapeutic actions of Weigela florida var. pauciflora include its ability to act as an adaptogen, promoting balance in the body, and its antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been reported to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, although further research is needed to confirm their specific effects.
